title: Gold agent expansion mh-dev-02
description: First isolate the canonical Astra worker: do not allow any legacy worker to write control/results. Then install and qualify additional development agents in user space: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) and stagewise CLI/agent where headless installation is supported. Do not use sudo and do not modify canonical transport. Verify versions/help and local-provider connectivity where supported. Finally run canonical bounded runtime E2E and publish fresh evidence with provider/model/execution/tests. If a legacy worker is still present, stop only that user-owned legacy process through the node's existing safe process-management path; never stop the canonical worker.
